events.title: Played the Veil of Time demo? We want to hear it
events.summary: Thanks to everyone who joined Raine in the Veil of Time demo this week. If you played it, tell us how it went in the Veil of Time discussions here on Steam. How the timing ring felt, what you'd change. We read every post. If you grabbed the demo during Next Fest and haven't launched it yet, it's already in your Steam library. Next Fest ends Sunday, Oct 26. Veil of Time is out Nov 19.

events.title: Demo update: Windows title screen fixed
events.summary: If the Veil of Time demo opened on a black title screen for you on Windows, sorry about that. It's fixed.Steam updates the demo automatically, so just relaunch it and you'll land on the menu.Thanks for giving it a try.

events.title: Veil of Time demo, live during Next Fest
events.summary: We are streaming the Veil of Time demo on this page during Steam Next Fest: the clock tower fight, a tavern brawl and the forest battles, with parries and timed strikes. The demo is free, so you can play it right now. Full game Nov 19.

events.title: The Veil of Time demo is out now for Steam Next Fest
events.summary: The Veil of Time demo is live on Steam for Next Fest. Raine is summoned to Castra Castle, where his uncle Gale hands him the family sword and a knight's writ. From there the quest board opens up, and the demo's main job is the bounty on the Wild Fernigus.Combat starts out on the map. When a hunter winds up a strike, swing into the flash and you parry it.
